title: Fixed Open Leaf Crown and Throat Roof Vent
description: One complete newly authored static rooftop vent appearance: a whole square flashing slab with a genuine circular opening joins a short thick hollow neck. A lower annular rim and upper domed cap retain sixteen continuously curved thick leaves around a wide bulbous crown; distinct open slots remain between the leaves. A central shaft and three radial supports occupy portions of the neck, so it is not declared unobstructed. Unlike the old horizontal mine fan or long three-bow turbine, this whole assembly combines a low broad open-slot crown over an open architectural throat and square flashing. No old mesh imported. Three opaque PBR materials, metre Z-up, ground-centred envelope. No actual ventilation, rotation, airflow, pressure, weatherproofing, roof fit, installation, load, engineering or safety claim; fixed artistic exterior only. No animation or interaction.
